findings.rootCause: LmdbPackedCostModel stamped every finite_binding_probe row DATABASE_EXACT while TripleStore.planningCardinality discarded the bounded page estimator's exact/hard-bound fields (post-merge GH-6006 estimator samples large ranges). Reachable site: frontier-OFF (statisticsView==null) legacy route via LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess -> LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateForPlanning -> TripleStore.planningCardinality; consequence is the plannedFrontierGuarantee=database_exact planned metric (explain text + LmdbOperatorFeedbackStats freezing row learning), as the critique restated.
findings.change: New LmdbPlanningCardinality record (rows, exact, lower/upper, certifiedBounds, scannedRows); TripleStore.cardinalityEstimate/planningCardinalityEstimate keep CardinalityEstimate exactness; LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateForPlanningQualified caches the record and escalates a non-exact 0 through a key-bounded exact walk (TripleStore.boundedExactCardinality, 8192 keys, doWithPriority, same getBestIndex/createMatcher/context semantics as getTriples); LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRowsQualified (frontier route = calibrated uncertified interval, legacy = record); LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteLookupEstimate aggregates exact=AND over probes and labels DATABASE_EXACT only when exact, CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY when finite certified bounds, else SCALAR_FALLBACK, publishing plannedFiniteProbeExact and finite plannedFrontierLower/UpperRows. Test reshaped so both the hub range and its complement exceed the range counter's leaf budget (the original 40k/64 data was legitimately exact via the complement path) with an explicit estimator precondition.

findings.rootCause: TripleStore.repeatedVariableCardinality and exactCardinality were unbounded planner-time scans holding a read lease; estimateExact would also publish a repeated-mask count as an exact fact. LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.exactBoundedFilterZero (row cap, INCONCLUSIVE never cached) and exactMatchingDistinctValues (distinct-term cap, SUPPORT_LIMIT status distinct from COMPLETE) were already bounded and already honest on inspection; their bound contract was undocumented and untested.
findings.change: exactCardinality(s,p,o,c,maxScannedRows) returns OptionalDouble.empty() at the cap (unbounded overload kept for non-planner callers); repeatedVariableCardinality(...,maxScannedRows) returns LmdbPlanningCardinality: exact when complete, else match-ratio extrapolation clamped to [matches, unrepeated hard upper bound] labelled non-exact; PLANNING_EXACT_SCAN_MAX_ROWS = LmdbStoreConfig.OPTIMIZER_SAMPLING_MAX_ROWS (4096); estimateExact returns -1 and skips the exact cache for a capped scan or a non-exact repeated result (critique minor addressed); shared planning cache stores the record so a capped result is never served exact. Filter-stats: planning-lease contract javadoc added to both probes and a new LmdbFilterProbeScanCapTest proves cap stop + no caching of capped results (not yet run).
